flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (enotification route, Epic37 routes commented out), utils/data/LinkData.tsx (LinkAdhoc), utils/Meta/AdhocNotification.ts. Folder pages/epic37 was deleted. ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi: no ad-hoc compose/send endpoint. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark 'Get Latip to switch email host to URA SMTP'. The story asks for a page to pick the mode (email/SMS) and single/multiple, then show one or many field rows. On main only the parent menu 'eNotifications' exists, holding Manage Templates and E-Notification Exclusion (LinkData.tsx:158-166). The Compose Email/SMS, Upload and Message Sent pages were deleted and all their routes and menu entries are commented out, so there is no mode selection and no single/multiple layout. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc). The paid demo is not proven by code on main; the feature was probably removed after the demo (cannot verify from repo, ask the team). The sheet marks OCMS37.8 'Fully paid' although no ad-hoc send code exists on main (see OCMS37.8). No relevant maintenance ticket (grep adhoc, compose, eNotification, SMS template: only unrelated template/cron tickets).
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the parent eNotifications menu exists; the compose pages and mode selector are not on main. Ask the team whether the feature was removed or moved to another repo, or mark as gap

steps.detail: The parent menu 'eNotifications' is added to the sidebar (menu.push(LinkAdhoc), LinkData.tsx:394) but its only children are Manage Templates and E-Notification Exclusion; the Compose Email, Compose SMS and Message Sent entries are commented out (LinkData.tsx:143-156). The entry point exists, the feature does not.

steps.step: Officer picks email or SMS as the sending mode
steps.detail: The Email vs SMS choice used to be two separate routes compose-email and compose-sms to Epic37.ComposeEmail / ComposeSMS. The Epic37 import (App.tsx:56) and routes (App.tsx:259-264) are commented out and pages/epic37 is not on main, so there is no mode selection screen. Only path/title constants remain in AdhocNotification.ts:33-46 with no page. Folder ocmsadminui/src/pages/epic37 (ComposeEmail, ComposeSMS, Upload, MessageSent) was deleted from main in commit 07aba128 (15 Apr 2025, git history, not evidence of running code); the Epic37 import at App.tsx:56 and the 6 compose/upload/message-sent routes at App.tsx:259-269 are now commented out, and the Compose Email/SMS/Message Sent menu entries at LinkData.tsx:143-156 are commented out too.

steps.step: Officer chooses to send a single or multiple messages
steps.detail: There is no single/multiple control. The multiple variant used to go through routes compose-email/upload and compose-sms/upload (App.tsx:261-267, commented out); only the UPLOAD constants remain in AdhocNotification.ts:47-56. No component on main reads this choice.

steps.step: A single row of recipient, subject and message is shown
steps.detail: There is no single-send screen. The closest form is CreateTemplateForm (subject and template content, CreateTemplateForm.tsx:116-140) but it saves a template, with no recipient field, schedule or send button; it is not this story's screen.

steps.step: Many rows of recipients, subjects and messages are shown
steps.detail: There is no multi-row screen. The recipient/message list components (Recipients, Messages, MessageList) exist only in git history (commit 07aba128), not on main. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).
